bestFitFields.bf_operating_situations: Owners seeking a Managed by Marriott / brand-managed path who want turnkey management, Marriott brand and systems expertise, and MxM topline (sales, revenue management, marketing) plus bottom-line scale support. Best-fit: assets where a Marriott management agreement / MxM operating model is the intended structure (per hotel-development.marriott.com Managed by Marriott).
bestFitFields.bf_not_ideal_for: Owners needing a pure third-party operator independent of Marriott brand affiliation; assets outside MxM managed coverage without a clear brand-managed mandate
